text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I could've sworn someone called for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
None of my classmates are here either. 
Could it be that the ones who called me 
are... the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is there something you need help with? If 
it's something I can do—
